newsitem.title: USA: Vanstar says won't meet analysts' Q4 figures.
newsitem.headline: Vanstar says won't meet analysts' Q4 figures.

text.p: Vanstar Corp said Friday it did not expect to meet analysts' earnings expectations of $0.23-$0.25 a share for its fourth quarter.
However, Vanstar also said it did expect "sequential increases in revenue and gross margin for the fourth quarter which are within the range of analysts' estimates."
The company did not provide specific details and officials were not available for comment.

Vanstar, which builds and manages computer network infrastructures, said it is continuing its commitment of significant expenditures to support growth in its higher-margin service businesses amid slower-than-expected revenue growth in that area.
As a result, it said, its "selling, general and administrative expenses will represent a higher percentage of revenue in the fourth quarter than previously expected."
Vanstar launched its intial public stock offering in March 1996. Its fiscal fourth quarter began February 1.
